紐約市審計長擬向三大退休基金提出50億美元私募氣候投資

紐約市審計長Mark Levine將向NYCERS、TRS、BERS三支退休基金提出50億美元私募市場氣候解決方案投資機會，涵蓋再生能源、電網與建築減碳。市府退休基金規模近3,000億美元，目標2035年氣候投資378億美元、2040年淨零。

學習單字
  • climate solutions investing氣候解決方案投資：投入減碳、能源轉型與氣候調適等可量化解方的資產配置策略
  • fiduciary review processes受託審查程序：基金受託人依受託責任對投資案進行的審核與核准流程
  • resilient energy infrastructure具韌性的能源基礎設施：能承受極端氣候與供應中斷的電網、儲能等設施

NYC Comptroller to propose $5 billion in new private-markets climate investments

NYC Comptroller Mark Levine plans to bring $5 billion of private-market climate deals to the NYCERS, TRS and BERS pension boards, spanning renewables, grids and building decarbonization. The ~$300 billion city pensions target $37.8 billion in climate investments by 2035 and net zero by 2040.

英國金融行為監理總署FCA放棄上市公司強制氣候揭露，改將UK SRS S1與S2全面採「遵循或解釋」，保留範疇三寬限；新制適用2027年1月1日起的會計期間、2028年首度申報，可能削弱投資人取得一致氣候資訊。

  • decision-useful有助決策的：資訊足以支援投資人判斷與決策

UK FCA drops mandatory IFRS-based climate reporting in favour of comply-or-explain

The FCA scrapped plans to make climate disclosures mandatory for UK listed companies, applying comply-or-explain to all UK SRS S1 and S2 requirements while keeping Scope 3 relief. Rules cover periods from 1 January 2027, with first reports in 2028, which may leave investors with patchier climate data.
